spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (प्लेहते)
To go, to move or approach.

m. (-हा)
The spleen; the organ or the disease of it, as in English; in the latter sense, however, it is equally applied to the enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c.
E.
प्लिह to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and the vowel made long; otherwise being प्लिहन्; and with क and टाप् affs., and the vowel long or short प्लिहा or प्लीहा.

m. (-घ्नः)
A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.)
E.
प्लीह the spleen, (the disease, &c.) घ्न what removes.

m. (-त्रुः)
A medical plant, commonly Rohera or Rohiṇī, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.)
E.
प्लीह for प्लीहन् the spleen, (the disease,) and शत्रु enemy; also प्लीहाशत्रु.

m. (-रिः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
प्लीहा the spleen, and अरि enemy.
